name: Check eligibility
steps: Validate session and device
Check account standing and tenure
Load Zelle profile if already enrolled

name: Register token
steps: Send one-time code and verify possession
Capture acceptance of Zelle terms
Register token-to-account link in the network directory

name: Resolve recipient
steps: Look up the token in the network directory
Return enrolled status and registered name
Save recipient to the customer's list

name: Confirm payee and warn
steps: Display the registered name
Show a scam warning for first payment to a new recipient
Log the acknowledgement

name: Check funds and limits
steps: Read available balance
Check daily and 30-day send limits
Screen memo text

name: Authorize payment
steps: Score risk in real time: device, behavior, payee newness, amount
Approve, step up, hold for review, or decline
Create the payment order

name: Execute payment
steps: Debit the sender's account (memo post)
Send the payment instruction to the Zelle network
Receiving bank credits the recipient, usually within minutes
Record the network acknowledgement

name: Settle and reconcile
steps: Interbank settlement runs on a schedule, after the customer sees the money
Post to the general ledger
Reconcile the network report to the ledger and work breaks

name: Notify both sides
steps: Send push and email to the sender
Network tells the receiving bank, which notifies the recipient
Write the activity record

name: Manage payment status
steps: Show status from the payment record
Allow cancel only while unclaimed
Expire unclaimed payments and return funds per network rules

name: Resolve claim
steps: Classify: unauthorized, scam, or sent in error
Unauthorized → Regulation E investigation
Qualifying imposter scam → network recovery rules
Sent in error → recall request to the receiving bank
